summary: Validated production compilation and unauthenticated responsive behavior for the enrollment UI. Direct Vite production build passed, but the package-script build is blocked by an illegal package name. Protected-route sign-in, empty-form validation, and desktop/mobile overflow checks passed; authenticated hospital landing and registration flows were not testable without credentials.

integration_issues.issue: yarn build fails before Vite runs because package.json name "MD INDIA" contains illegal characters; direct ./node_modules/.bin/vite build succeeds.

action_items: Rename package.json name to a valid npm package identifier so the documented yarn build works.
Provide approved test credentials or a supported authenticated test fixture for landing and registration-flow verification.
critical_code_review_comments: The production build is not reproducible through the package.json build script because the package name contains spaces and uppercase characters.
The direct build emits an /env.js script type warning, a Tailwind selector warning, and a circular Accordion chunk warning; assess these before release.

success_rate.backend: N/A - no backend requested or exercised
success_rate.frontend: 75% - unauthenticated checks passed; authenticated flow not covered

context_for_next_testing_agent: At http://localhost:3000/provider-masters/empanel, the protected route renders the sign-in form without changing the URL. Accessible Username/Password fields and Sign in button are present; empty submit shows 'Enter your username and password.' No horizontal overflow was observed at 390x844 or 1920x1080. Credentials guidance file /app/memory/test_credentials.md was absent, so do not invent credentials.
rca of the issue: The package script invokes Yarn, which validates package.json metadata before executing Vite. The package name is 'MD INDIA', and Yarn rejects the embedded space/uppercase format as an illegal package name. Invoking Vite directly bypasses that metadata validation and completes the production build.
